# Microsoft OneNote

Digital notebook for capturing and organizing notes, drawings, and information

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/onenote/.

## Actions

- **Copy notebook in group**: Copies a OneNote notebook to the Notebooks folder in the destination Documents library.
- **Copy notebook in site**: Copies a OneNote notebook to the destination site in the SharePoint documents library.
- **Create group OneNote page**: Creates a new OneNote page in the default section of the default notebook for a Microsoft 365 group.
- **Create OneNote page in section**: Creates a new OneNote page in a specific section for the signed-in user.
- **Create user OneNote page**: Creates a new OneNote page in the default section of the default notebook for a specific user.
- **Delete OneNote page for user**: Deletes a OneNote page from a user's OneNote workspace.
- **Delete OneNote page from section**: Delete a specific OneNote page from a section within a notebook in a group.
- **Delete OneNote page from site**: Deletes a OneNote page from a SharePoint site.
- **Delete page content from section group section**: Deletes the HTML content of a OneNote page within a section in a section group in a Microsoft 365 group's OneNote workspace.
- **Delete user OneNote page from section**: Deletes a OneNote page from a section within a section group in a user's notebook.
- **Get a OneNote page from a section group section** (read-only): Retrieves a specific OneNote page from a section within a section group in a Microsoft 365 group's notebook.
- **Get a OneNote page from user** (read-only): Retrieves a specific OneNote page from a user's OneNote notebooks.
- **Get a OneNote section from a group** (read-only): Retrieves a specific OneNote section from a Microsoft 365 group.
- **Get a OneNote section from a site** (read-only): Retrieves a specific OneNote section from a SharePoint site.
- **Get notebook from web URL** (read-only): Retrieves a OneNote notebook by using its web URL path.
- **Get notebook section group** (read-only): Retrieves a specific section group from a OneNote notebook within a Microsoft 365 group.
- **Get OneNote page from site section group section** (read-only): Retrieves a specific OneNote page from a section within a section group in a SharePoint site notebook.
- **Get parent section group from user section** (read-only): Retrieves the parent section group of a OneNote section within a user's notebook.
- **Get user notebook** (read-only): Retrieves the properties and relationships of a OneNote notebook by ID for a specific user.
- **List group OneNote pages** (read-only): Lists all OneNote pages from a Microsoft 365 group.
- **List notebook section groups** (read-only): Retrieves a list of section groups from the specified notebook within a Microsoft 365 group.
- **List pages from a group notebook section** (read-only): Lists all OneNote pages from a specific section within a notebook in a Microsoft 365 group.
- **List pages from a group section** (read-only): Lists all OneNote pages from a specific section in a Microsoft 365 group.
- **List pages in section** (read-only): Retrieves a list of OneNote pages from a specific section for the current user.
- **List site notebook section groups** (read-only): Retrieves a list of section groups from the specified notebook within a SharePoint site.
- **List user notebook sections** (read-only): Lists all OneNote sections from a specified notebook belonging to a user.
- **List user notebooks** (read-only): Lists all OneNote notebooks accessible by a specific user.
- **Update my OneNote section**: Updates the navigation property sections in me.
- **Update section in site notebook**: Updates a OneNote section within a notebook in a SharePoint site.
- **Update section in user notebook**: Updates a OneNote section within a user's notebook.
- **Update site section group section**: Updates a OneNote section within a section group in a SharePoint site notebook.
- **Copy group section to section group**: Copies a OneNote section from a Microsoft 365 group's notebook into another section group.
- **Copy section to notebook (site context)**: Copies a OneNote section to a specific notebook within a SharePoint site.
- **Copy section to notebook (user)**: Copies a OneNote section to a specific notebook for a specified user.
- **Copy section to section group (user)**: Copies a OneNote section to a specific section group for a specified user.
- **Copy site page to section**: Copies a OneNote page from a SharePoint site to a destination section.
- **Copy user page to section**: Copy a OneNote page from a user's notebook to a specified section.
- **Count notebook section group sections** (read-only): Gets the count of OneNote sections within a section group in a user's notebook.
- **Count site notebook section group sections** (read-only): Gets the count of sections within a OneNote section group in a SharePoint site notebook.
- **Create group notebook**: Creates a new OneNote notebook within a Microsoft 365 group.
- **Create section group in group notebook**: Creates a new section group within a OneNote notebook that belongs to a Microsoft 365 group.
- **Create section in section group**: Creates a new OneNote section within a specified section group of a Microsoft 365 group.
- **Create section in site notebook**: Creates a new OneNote section within a specified notebook in a SharePoint site.
- **Create section in user notebook**: Creates a new OneNote section within a specified notebook for a specific user.
- **Create section in user section group**: Creates a new OneNote section within a specified section group for a specific user.
- **Create section in user's section group**: Creates a new OneNote section within a specified section group of a notebook for the signed-in user.
- **Create user notebook**: Creates a new OneNote notebook for the signed-in user.
- **Create user section page**: Creates a new OneNote page in a specific section of a user's notebook.
- **Get group OneNote operation status** (read-only): Retrieves the status of a long-running OneNote operation for a group.
- **Get OneNote page content for user** (read-only): Gets the HTML content of a specific OneNote page for a user.
- **Get OneNote page content from section** (read-only): Retrieves the HTML content of a specific OneNote page from a section for the signed-in user.
- **Get OneNote page content from SharePoint site** (read-only): Retrieves the HTML content of a specific OneNote page within a SharePoint site.
- **Get OneNote page from site** (read-only): Retrieves a specific OneNote page from a SharePoint site.
- **Get OneNote resource content by ID** (read-only): Retrieves the binary content of a specific OneNote resource using its ID.
- **Get site notebook page preview** (read-only): Retrieves a text preview of a specific OneNote page from a section within a section group in a SharePoint site-hosted notebook.
- **Get site OneNote operation status** (read-only): Retrieves the status of a long-running OneNote operation for a SharePoint site.
- **List group section group section groups** (read-only): Lists all section groups from a specified parent section group within a Microsoft 365 group's OneNote notebook.
- **List section group sections** (read-only): Lists all OneNote sections from a specific section group within a Microsoft 365 group's OneNote.
- **List site sections** (read-only): Retrieves a list of OneNote sections from a SharePoint site.
- **Update my OneNote page content**: Update the content of a OneNote page for the signed-in user.
- **Update OneNote page content**: Update the content of a OneNote page within a Microsoft 365 group using HTML patch commands.
- **Update site OneNote page content**: Update the content of a OneNote page within a SharePoint site.
